notes.title: Update 2.02
notes.content:
👫 You can play with a big group! 👫 
When there are more than 5 players remaining, the maximum number of trash cans/black will be increased by 1.
(6 player mode is being worked on! 😁 )

😖 5 seconds is too fast...😖 
When the time up function is turned on, the time limit is now 5 seconds after 100 turns have passed.
